comments.author: @AmazingDiscoveriesTopUS
comments.text: Siquijor is truly fascinating! An island surrounded by legends of witchcraft, known for its honestly and peaceful way of life.

comments.author: @ImpossibleTravelogue99
comments.text: craping wild hog-plum bark with a metal spoon to make sour astringent juice for raw fish ceviche because real vinegar is too pricey... poor islanders turn every poisonous bush into survival food

comments.author: @lifeonearth68
comments.text: The part about neighbors showing up to help with farm work without asking for money really stood out to me🤩🤩. Do people in Siquijor still practice alayon today?

replies.author: @MindfulTravelUS
replies.text: It’s truly inspiring to see such strong community bonds, and the alayon tradition remains a cornerstone of life on the island.

comments.author: @mdrakibulhasan7928
comments.text: I used to watch other people talk about manifesting like it was the easiest thing in the world, while I couldn’t get anything to work. I eventually tried Nadia Marsh arche type quiz out of pure curiosity, and the result matched me almost uncomfortably well. I wasn’t expecting that at all. It only takes a couple of minutes, so it’s worth checking out ❤️

replies.author: @MindfulTravelUS
replies.text: Thank you for sharing your personal experience with us!
